# Model families

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_families.py from the registries; do not edit -->

AI Made Easy has 763 blocks in 9 families. A design's family follows from its blocks; it decides how the design is validated, which frameworks train it and what code it exports. Every family runs the generic checks first (unknown blocks, unconnected ports, cycles, port roles, missing optional libraries), then the rules listed below. Messages are quoted from the code; "…" stands for the values filled in for your design. Many end in a one-click Quick Fix.

## Neural network

`neural`: Layer graphs trained with PyTorch or Keras.

**Tasks**

- **Multi-class classification** (`multiclass`): Assign each sample exactly one of N classes.
- **Binary classification** (`binary`): Decide between two classes from one output (logit).
- **Multi-label classification** (`multilabel`): Any number of N labels can apply to a sample (one logit per label).
- **Regression** (`regression`): Predict one or more continuous values.
- **Distribution matching** (`distribution`): Match a target probability distribution (e.g. KL-divergence training).
- **Object detection** (`detection`): Find every object: a box, a class and a confidence per object.
- **Instance segmentation** (`instance_segmentation`): Find every object and outline it with a pixel mask.
- **Keypoint detection** (`keypoints`): Find objects and their keypoints (joints, corners, landmarks).
- **Semantic segmentation** (`semantic_segmentation`): Give every pixel a class (background, road, tumour, ...).
- **Time-series forecasting** (`forecasting`): Predict the next steps of one or many time series, optionally with uncertainty.
- **Keyword spotting** (`keyword_spotting`): Recognise which short spoken command a clip contains.
- **Speech recognition (CTC)** (`speech_recognition`): Transcribe speech to text with per-frame character scores and CTC.
- **Audio tagging** (`audio_tagging`): Detect every sound event present in a clip (multi-label).
- **Variational autoencoder** (`vae_generation`): Learn a latent space that reconstructs images and generates new ones from the prior.
- **Image generation (GAN)** (`gan_generation`): Train a generator against a discriminator to produce realistic images from noise.
- **Image generation (diffusion)** (`diffusion_generation`): Learn to remove noise step by step, then generate images from pure noise.
- **Language modeling** (`language_modeling`): Predict the next token of text; generate continuations of a prompt.
- **Sequence to sequence** (`sequence_to_sequence`): Map a source text to a target text (translation, rewriting, summarisation).
- **Density estimation (normalizing flow)** (`density_estimation`): Learn the probability density of the data with an invertible network: exact log-likelihoods for any point and new samples drawn from the model.
- **Node classification** (`node_classification`): Predict a class for every node of a graph from its features and its neighbours.
- **Graph classification** (`graph_classification`): Predict a class for a whole graph (a molecule, a protein, a network).
- **Link prediction** (`link_prediction`): Embed the nodes and score node pairs: which missing edges exist?
- **Recommendation** (`recommendation`): Learn which items each user will like from past interactions; rank items per user.
- **Reinforcement learning** (`reinforcement_learning`): Learn a policy that maximises reward by acting in an environment.

#### Every network

- *error*: … needs floating-point input but receives integer indices from …. Add an Embedding before it, or set the Input dtype to float32.
- *warning*: … applies … internally, so the final … squashes the logits twice and slows learning. Remove it and output raw logits (apply it only at inference time).
- *error*: CrossEntropyLoss needs at least 2 output units (one per class); the model outputs …. For binary targets use BCEWithLogits with 1 unit.
- *error*: … has … classes but the model outputs … units. Set the last layer to … outputs.
- *error*: … has … classes but … is set to …. Set its classes to ….
- *warning*: … learns from the embedding the model outputs; end the model with a Dense layer (the embedding size), not ….
- *warning*: Regression output passes through …, which restricts predictions to a bounded range. Use a linear output unless the target range matches.
- *warning*: Two Dense layers with no activation between them compose into a single linear map. Insert an activation (e.g. ReLU/GELU).
- *warning*: … directly after … has no effect.
- *warning*: Dropout directly before the Output perturbs the logits themselves. Move it before the final linear layer.
- *warning*: This Dense layer has … weights (… → …). Reduce the input with pooling or a smaller layer to save memory.
- *warning*: stride … is larger than kernel_size …: some input positions are never read.
- *warning*: Self-attention is permutation-invariant and this sequence carries no position information. Add a Positional Encoding after the Embedding.
- *error*: BatchNorm needs a batch size of at least 2 in training; increase batch_size or use LayerNorm/GroupNorm.
- *warning*: BatchNorm statistics are noisy with batch size …; consider GroupNorm or a larger batch.
- *error*: … produces … features per sample but the Input holds … values (…). Make them equal.
- *error*: … samples are … but the Input expects …. Set the Input shape to '…'.
- *warning*: … samples are …; the Input … has the same size, so samples will be reshaped, not resized.
- *error*: … expects log-probabilities; end the model with a LogSoftmax layer
- *error*: … expects probabilities in [0, 1]; end the model with a Sigmoid layer, or use BCE (logits) without it

- *error*: … datasets produce floating-point features: set the Input dtype to float32

- *warning*: Training needs about … GB at batch … but the budget is … GB…: lower the batch size (gradient accumulation keeps the effective batch) or turn on mixed precision
- *warning*: Inference takes about … ms per sample…, over the … ms budget: use a smaller backbone, fewer or narrower layers, or a lower input resolution

## Classic ML pipeline

`classic`: scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost pipelines.

**Tasks**

- **Clustering** (`clustering`): Group similar rows without labels; a label column, if any, only scores the groups.
- **Anomaly detection** (`anomaly_detection`): Flag rows that do not look like the rest; labels, if any, are used only to evaluate.

Also trains Multi-class classification, Binary classification, Regression (shared with Neural network).

**Blocks**

- *Anomaly Detection* (5): Elliptic Envelope, Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor, One-Class SVM, One-Class SVM (SGD)
- *Clustering* (13): Affinity Propagation, Agglomerative Clustering, BIRCH, Bayesian Gaussian Mixture, Bisecting K-Means, DBSCAN, Gaussian Mixture, HDBSCAN, Mean Shift, Mini-Batch k-Means, OPTICS, Spectral Clustering, k-Means
- *Gradient Boosting* (6): CatBoost Classifier, CatBoost Regressor, LightGBM Classifier, LightGBM Regressor, XGBoost Classifier, XGBoost Regressor
- *Linear Models* (32): ARD Regression, Baseline (Dummy) Classifier, Baseline (Dummy) Regressor, Bayesian Ridge, Elastic Net, Elastic Net (CV), Gamma Regression, Huber Regressor, Lasso, Lasso (CV), Lasso (LARS), Lasso (information criterion), Least-Angle Regression, Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Logistic Regression (CV), Orthogonal Matching Pursuit, PLS Regression, Passive-Aggressive Classifier, Passive-Aggressive Regressor, Perceptron, Poisson Regressor, Quantile Regression, RANSAC Regression, Ridge, Ridge (CV), Ridge Classifier, Ridge Classifier (CV), SGD Classifier, SGD Regressor, Theil-Sen Regression, Tweedie Regression
- *Neighbors & Bayes* (11): Bernoulli Naive Bayes, Complement Naive Bayes, Gaussian Naive Bayes, Linear Discriminant Analysis, Multinomial Naive Bayes, Nearest Centroid, Quadratic Discriminant Analysis, Radius Neighbors Classifier, Radius Neighbors Regressor, k-Nearest Neighbors Classifier, k-Nearest Neighbors Regressor
- *Neural (sklearn)* (2): MLP Classifier, MLP Regressor
- *Support Vector Machines* (10): Calibrated Linear SVM, Gaussian Process Classifier, Gaussian Process Regressor, Kernel Ridge, Linear SVC, Linear SVR, Nu-SVC, Nu-SVR, SVC, SVR
- *Trees & Ensembles* (16): AdaBoost Classifier, AdaBoost Regressor, Bagging Classifier, Bagging Regressor, Decision Tree Classifier, Decision Tree Regressor, Extra Tree Classifier, Extra Tree Regressor, Extra Trees Classifier, Extra Trees Regressor, Gradient Boosting Classifier, Gradient Boosting Regressor, Histogram Gradient Boosting Classifier, Histogram Gradient Boosting Regressor, Random Forest Classifier, Random Forest Regressor

**Design rules**

- *error*: … is a neural-network block; a project is either a neural network or a classic ML pipeline
- *error*: only one estimator per pipeline; compare models in separate projects or use Hyperparameter Search
- *error*: … needs non-negative features, but the pipeline can produce negative values (standardization / PCA / power transform). Use Min-Max scaling or remove the step.
- *warning*: … needs non-negative features: add Min-Max scaling (and no standardization) before it
- *warning*: search parameters … are not exposed on …; they are passed to the estimator as-is
- *error*: n_neighbors must be smaller than the number of samples
- *error*: score_func '…' does not match the … estimator
- *warning*: Box-Cox needs strictly positive features; prefer Yeo-Johnson unless the data is positive

## LLM workflow

`llm`: Hugging Face generation, fine-tuning and retrieval workflows (exported as scripts).

**Tasks**

- **Text generation (LLM)** (`text_generation`): Prompt a pretrained language model and get text back.
- **LLM fine-tuning** (`llm_finetuning`): Adapt a pretrained language model to your examples (supervised fine-tuning, LoRA).
- **Retrieval-augmented answering (RAG)** (`retrieval_qa`): Answer questions from your documents: retrieve the relevant passages, then generate.

**Blocks**

- *LLM* (15): Chat Memory, Document Loader, Embedding Model, Fine-tune (SFT), Generation Params, HF Model, HF Tokenizer, LoRA / QLoRA Config, Output Parser (JSON), Prompt Template, RAG Pipeline, Retriever, SFT Dataset, Text Splitter, Vector Store

**Design rules**

The generic checks and the neural network rules for the layers it uses.
